svg.title: The steps of a safe swap
svg.desc: The seven steps of a safe swap: 1 plan (reserve VRAM, save the rollback), 2 route off (no new requests reach the old instance), 3 drain (in-flight requests finish), 4 unload the old instance, 5 load the new instance, 6 health (ready, then one probe), 7 route on (traffic flows again). Steps 2 to 4 take the old instance out, 5 to 7 bring the new one in. Make before break: when the GPU has room the order is 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 4, 7, so capacity never drops. If a step fails, the old instance is routed back on or reloaded from its saved spec; if that fails too the swap ends failed, the deployment is degraded, a critical alert fires and auto-heal can take over. Every step is saved, so a new jobs leader resumes the swap.
